thesis.evidence: mock-history-light.png argues it at once: periwinkle start dots and ink talk lines on the day score and in every row, kept text above said text with the fillers struck. mock-try-it-light.png now waits as a dot and an empty line, mock-recordings-light.png hangs turns on speaker discs, mock-dictionary-light.png has clip discs and mock-settings-light.png a keycap with a voice dot. It thins on mock-insights-light.png, where nothing is round, and the kit spends periwinkle on focus rings and checkmarks (kit-light.png), which blurs 'periwinkle means voice'.

signature.evidence: mock-history-light.png: the day score and the matching talk line under every row come from hold, talk, let go, and the new 'time talking' key stops the line reading as a span of the hour axis. mock-try-it-light.png lands the first dictation as the same dot and line, and mock-overlay-ring-light.png closes it into the ring. It does not reach mock-recordings-light.png, whose who-spoke strip is plain blocks, and the renderer's history-light.png carries none of it (a listed limit).

content.evidence: mock-history-light.png draws the product promise: kept text at reading size, said text beneath with 'um so', 'like' and 'eight weeks oh actually' struck, corrections underlined, a time gutter and a butter learned line. mock-dictionary-light.png gives each term five clip discs and struck mishearings; mock-recordings-light.png a speaker and time-code gutter. Slips: '3 of 5' still repeats the discs, and the said text strikes 'prominent' while the learned line says 'Preman' and mock-dictionary-light.png says 'prominent' is never swapped.

hierarchy.evidence: mock-history-light.png reads title, day score, the ink selected row, then the kept text, with Copy ⌘C at the trailing edge of the reader header. mock-insights-light.png reads 7,719, then the area, then one small line. mock-settings-light.png leads with the filled keycap and groups by space. mock-try-it-light.png has a clear first read but an empty lower half, and the renderer's full-width slabs (Copy in history-light.png) still fight the content, a listed limit.

type.evidence: Outfit 600 titles at about 56px with tight tracking and a 132px numeral (mock-insights-light.png) against Inter 21px kept text, 15px said text and small tabular time codes (mock-history-light.png): real contrast, one job per style. Tracked caps sit only on section labels (KEPT, WHAT YOU SAID, WHO SPOKE, TERMS). The renderer keeps the roles (dictionary-light.png, settings-light.png), though welcome-light.png sets 'Youch!' barely larger than its tagline.

colour.evidence: mock-history-light.png and mock-history-dark.png keep the budget: periwinkle on the start dots, play disc and mark; ink (cream in dark) for selection and Copy; butter once, as the learned disc. Dark is designed, with cream fills and the area as a quiet periwinkle plane (mock-insights-dark.png). The kit still puts periwinkle on states that are not voice, the field focus border and halo and the select checkmarks (kit-light.png, kit-dark.png), and the renderer's area tint nearly vanishes in insights-dark.png.

restraint.evidence: Round 2's strays are gone: the switch is a square slug (settings-light.png), the Insights caption is plain text (insights-light.png) and the inspector frame is gone (history-light.png). The mocks keep one language: 6px controls, 0 on planes, round only for voice. Left over: the periwinkle field-focus halo (kit-light.png) and a soft shadow fading along the inspector's left edge in light (history-light.png, dictionary-light.png, settings-light.png), against 'no shadows anywhere'.

craft.evidence: The mocks are clean, with one strong edge per pane and tabular times (mock-history-light.png), and round 2's progress and menu-inset bugs are fixed (try-it-light.png, kit-light.png). What remains: the error field still differs from rest only by a grey halo, faint in kit-dark.png; mock-try-it-light.png puts Back and the step bar at 44px while its content sits at 96px, and still says 'Click the box' with no box drawn; the left-set primary label sits over a centred secondary label (history-light.png); note icons float above their one line of text (history-light.png, recordings-light.png); segmented groups are inset a few pixels from the rule edge (settings-light.png).

distinct.evidence: With the name hidden, mock-history-light.png (day score and talk lines), mock-settings-light.png (keycaps, stop tracks, square slug switches) and mock-welcome-light.png (poster wordmark over a keyboard row) could only be Youch!. Defaults remain on mock-insights-light.png (a big number over a smoothed area) and in the renderer's full-width slabs and chevron rows (history-light.png).

owner-fit.evidence: It answers 'kind of Bauhaus ... a little neo-brutal pop' with poster titles, 2px ink lines and ink fills (mock-welcome-light.png, mock-history-light.png), keeps the Mail-style two-pane History, the area graph (mock-insights-light.png), butter as one small disc and no highlight band, and shows the static only while capturing (mock-overlay-pill-light.png). Still to raise with the owner: D-037's pills and periwinkle-filled selection are replaced by 6px corners and ink fills, and the static sits on an opaque dark disc rather than the see-through circle he praised.

generic: mock-insights-light.png: a huge number over a smoothed area chart with a label-value line beneath is the stock analytics hero, and the bezier smoothing invents dips between days.

The renderer's main actions are full-width ink slabs with left-set labels in the middle of the content: Copy in history-light.png, Add in dictionary-light.png, Export in recordings-light.png, Finish in try-it-light.png.
Label-value rows with a chevron on every line (the inspector in history-light.png, the models list in settings-light.png, the transcript rows in recordings-light.png) read as an iOS Settings list.
